Người học \u003cb\u003ekhông được nộp sản phẩm do AI tạo ra toàn bộ hoặc phần lớn nội dung\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eKhi có sử dụng AI trong quá trình làm bài, người học cần ghi rõ công cụ và cách sử dụng trong phần tài liệu tham khảo hoặc ghi chú.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eMọi hành vi lạm dụng AI nhằm gian lận sẽ bị coi là vi phạm liêm chính học thuật và xử lý theo quy định của nhà trường.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e","en":"\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003c/i\u003eStudy materials include: the course syllabus, lecture slides, and major assignments stored on the faculty (school) learning resource server.Students need to download, print, and bring these materials to class.\u003cbr\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eIn addition to the provided materials, students can search for additional related resources on the Internet, such as guides, sample neuralnetwork architectures, sample programs, and datasets.\u003cbr\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eStudents are required to attend all classes and actively participate in discussions to clarify issues.\u003cbr\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eAt home, students should thoroughly study the materials, practice programming more, and complete major assignments fully.\u003ci\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003c/b\u003eA\u003cb\u003e\u003c/b\u003ecademic Integrity and Use of AI Tools\u003c/li\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eStudents must comply with the university’s academic integrity regulations.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eThe use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) is permitted only for supportive purposes such as finding references, generating ideas, checking grammar, or improving presentation. Students are \u003cb\u003enot allowed to submit work that is wholly or substantially generated by AI\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWhen AI tools are used in assignments, students must clearly indicate the tool and how it was used in the references or footnotes.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eAny misuse of AI for academic dishonesty will be considered a violation of academic integrity and will be handled in accordance with the university’s regulations.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"ghiChu":"{\"vi\":\"\u003cp\u003eSinh viên sẽ nhận điểm điểm tổng kết môn học bằng điểm BTL nếu điểm BTL nhỏ hơn hoặc bằng 3\u003c/p\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\",\"en\":\"\u003cp\u003eIf the assignment\u0027s score is less than or equal to 3 then the final grade for the course is the same as the\u0026nbsp;assignment\u0027 score.\u003c/p\u003e\"}","check_useSoTcGoc":0,"check_hocPhanTotNghiep":0}
